completelyRegularSpace_iff.type:
completelyRegularSpace_iff.{u_1} : ∀ (X : Type u_1) [inst : TopologicalSpace.{u_1} X],
  Iff (@CompletelyRegularSpace.{u_1} X inst)
    (∀ (x : X) (K : Set.{u_1} X),
      @IsClosed.{u_1} X inst K →
        x ∉ K →
          ∃ f,
            And
              (@Continuous.{u_1, 0} X (@Set.Elem.{0} Real unitInterval) inst
                (@instTopologicalSpaceSubtype.{0} Real
                  (fun x => @Membership.mem.{0, 0} Real (Set.{0} Real) (@Set.instMembership.{0} Real) unitInterval x)
                  (@UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace.{0} Real
                    (@PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace.{0} Real Real.pseudoMetricSpace)))
                f)
              (And
                (@Eq.{1} (@Set.Elem.{0} Real unitInterval) (f x)
                  (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} (@Set.Elem.{0} Real unitInterval) (nat_lit 0)
                    (@Zero.toOfNat0.{0} (@Set.Elem.{0} Real unitInterval)
                      (@Set.Icc.instZero.{0} Real Real.semiring Real.partialOrder Real.instIsOrderedRing))))
                (@Set.EqOn.{u_1, 0} X (@Set.Elem.{0} Real unitInterval) f
                  (@OfNat.ofNat.{u_1} (X → @Set.Elem.{0} Real unitInterval) (nat_lit 1)
                    (@One.toOfNat1.{u_1} (X → @Set.Elem.{0} Real unitInterval)
                      (@Pi.instOne.{u_1, 0} X (fun a => @Set.Elem.{0} Real unitInterval) fun i =>
                        @Set.Icc.instOne.{0} Real Real.semiring Real.partialOrder Real.instIsOrderedRing)))
                  K)))

@isProperMap_iff_isClosedMap_and_compact_fibers.{u_1,
    u_2} : ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : TopologicalSpace.{u_1} X] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace.{u_2} Y]
  {f : X → Y},
